questions.q: Identify the error: “Not only he is a good doctor but also a kind human being.”
questions.why: 'Not only' at the start requires inversion: 'Not only is he'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct phrasal verb: “The negotiators managed to ____ their differences before the deadline.”
questions.why: 'Iron out' means to settle problems or disagreements. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive construction: “Nobody can solve this problem.”
opts: This problem cannot be solved by anyone.
This problem can not be solved by nobody.
This problem could not be solved by anyone.
This problem is not solved by anyone.
questions.why: Negative subject becomes 'cannot be + past participle ... by anyone'; avoid double negatives. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “obfuscate”:
questions.why: To obfuscate is to make unclear. GPSC CBRT, Feb 2026.

questions.q: Choose the correct conjunction: “Not until the results were announced ____ he realise his mistake.”
questions.why: After 'Not until' at the start, the auxiliary comes before the subject: 'did he realise'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the error: “Hardly had she entered the room than the lights went out.”
questions.why: 'Hardly' pairs with 'when' (or 'before'), not 'than'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: “He is the legal heir ____ a large fortune.”
questions.why: 'Heir to' a property or title. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: “She is two years ____ than her cousin.”
questions.why: 'Than' follows 'older'; 'elder' is not used with 'than'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: “She is entitled ____ a pension after retirement.”
Choose the correct passive construction: “The principal gave the students certificates.”
opts: The students gave certificates by the principal.
The principal was given certificates to the students.
The students were given certificates by the principal.
Certificates are given the students by the principal.
questions.why: With two objects, either can become the subject; the others misuse tense or roles. GPSC-style practice item.
